text: Patterns such as infinite scroll, autoplaying videos. <break time="0.8s" /> Or requiring an account just to make a purchase. <break time="0.8s" /> All interfere with the users control over their own experience. <break time="0.8s" /> From a sustainability perspective. <break time="0.8s" /> Many of these patterns encourage. <break time="0.8s" /> Overconsumption of data and attention. <break time="0.8s" /> Infinite scroll keeps loading new content. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether the user wants it or not. <break time="0.8s" /> Increasing data usage and device processing. <break time="0.8s" /> Autoplay forces media to load and play. <break time="0.8s" /> Even for people who may never watch it. <break time="0.8s" /> These choices consume more energy. <break time="0.8s" /> On both the users device. <break time="0.8s" /> And the servers delivering the content. <break time="0.8s" /> Take the decision by a popular music streaming platform. <break time="0.8s" /> To replace static album artwork with short video loops by default. <break time="0.8s" /> This change significantly increases. <break time="0.8s" /> Data usage and battery consumption. <break time="0.8s" /> While the option to disable it. <break time="0.8s" /> Is buried deep in the settings. <break time="0.8s" /> As a result. <break time="0.8s" /> Most users consume more resources. <break time="0.8s" /> Unless they actively search for a way to opt out. <break time="0.8s" /> It is important to acknowledge. <break time="0.8s" /> That web design always nudges behavior. <break time="0.8s" /> In some way. <break time="0.8s" /> Showing consequences and highlighting options. <break time="0.8s" /> Are all forms of influence. <break time="0.8s" /> The ethical line is not whether nudging exists. <break time="0.8s" /> But whether it is transparent, reversible. <break time="0.8s" /> And aligned with the users interests. <break time="0.8s" /> In many cases. <break time="0.8s" /> The most responsible approach. <break time="0.8s" /> Is to make the lower impact option the default. <break time="0.8s" /> While keeping alternatives clearly available. <break time="0.8s" /> Defaults are powerful. <break time="0.8s" /> And when chosen carefully. <break time="0.8s" /> They can reduce environmental impact. <break time="0.8s" /> Without removing user agency.
